sessionStart.bash: mkdir -p "$HOME/.copilot/logs" && printf '%s\n' "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')] SESSION_START - Copilot mirror hooks loaded" >> "$HOME/.copilot/logs/copilot-mirror.log" && printf '{"ok":true,"message":"session start logged"}'

sessionEnd.bash: mkdir -p "$HOME/.copilot/logs" && printf '%s\n' "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')] SESSION_END - Copilot session closed" >> "$HOME/.copilot/logs/copilot-mirror.log" && printf '{"ok":true,"message":"session end logged"}'

postToolUse.bash: printf '{"ok":true,"message":"memory tool used: keep entity names specific and relations active-voice"}'
